results.title: [PDF] Leonardo da Vinci's Struggles with Representations of Reality
results.content: According to Leonardo’s depictions in Arundel MS 263, f143 (Figs 1b,c), he conducted an experiment where he would move a vase filled with granular materials (quantita disscontinua) while allowing the contents to fall from the neck of the vase to the right of the point of inception “a.” He reported (deduced by the authors of this article from Leonardo’s figures) that he could exactly mimic the natural motion of falling objects (i.e. a uniform acceleration) and showed that the granular particles, or continuum liquid, would line up in a straight line, repre-senting the hypotenuse of an isosceles right triangle, consistent with his prediction.
